title: Cold Today, Sunny Tomorrow
text:
It is cold today. I wear a warm coat and a hat. My friend wears boots and gloves.

Tomorrow it will be sunny. We will not need our coats. We will go to the park in T-shirts.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
What does the writer's friend wear?
Why will the writer not need a coat tomorrow?
How does the writer probably feel about tomorrow?

vocabulary.definition: having a low temperature; not warm
a long piece of clothing worn outside to keep warm
a public green area where people go to relax

paragraph_translations: Сьогодні холодно. Я ношу тепле пальто і капелюх. Мій друг носить чоботи і рукавиці.
Завтра буде сонячно. Нам не знадобляться пальто. Ми підемо в парк у футболках.
